text: Accepted reply handling tests the first parsed email from replyTo or author with an anchored noreply expression. The plus sign is allowed after reply in the suffix group, not anywhere in an address. A warning offers cancel or continue; it is not a send prohibition, nor a domain-substring match. No regex experiment or actual warning UI was run. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.
title: The noreply warning matches the address local part and lets the user continue
